name: Mellts

attributes.attribute: a Welsh god of whom little is known
appears to have been an ancestral god

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Mellts is a Welsh god. Very little survives about him. He seems to have been an ancestor god, one who watched over a line of kin. The record gives no more.

okr.objective: Document the scant the Welsh god Mellts.
key_results: the record about him is thin
he seems to be a god of the ancestors
